_note: Coordinates and hours are approximate; verify before evaluation (see seed/geocode.py). Fees are for Indian citizens. 'daily' expands to all seven days.

pois.name: Amber Fort
pois.description: Hilltop Rajput fort-palace of red sandstone and marble; Sheesh Mahal mirror hall.

pois.name: Hawa Mahal
pois.description: The 'Palace of Winds' with its 953-window honeycomb facade.

pois.name: City Palace
pois.description: Royal residence with courtyards, museums and the Peacock Gate.

pois.name: Jantar Mantar
pois.description: UNESCO-listed 18th-century astronomical observatory with the world's largest stone sundial.

pois.name: Albert Hall Museum
pois.description: State museum in Indo-Saracenic building; also open for evening visits.

pois.name: Nahargarh Fort
pois.description: Aravalli ridge fort overlooking the Pink City.

pois.name: Jaigarh Fort
pois.description: Military fort above Amber, home to the Jaivana cannon.

pois.name: Jal Mahal (viewpoint)
pois.description: Palace in the middle of Man Sagar Lake, viewed from the promenade.

pois.name: Birla Mandir
pois.description: White-marble Lakshmi Narayan temple below Moti Dungri.

pois.name: Galta Ji (Monkey Temple)
pois.description: Temple complex with natural spring tanks in a mountain pass.

pois.name: Patrika Gate, Jawahar Circle
pois.description: Colourfully painted gateway, one of Jaipur's most photographed spots.

pois.name: Govind Dev Ji Temple
pois.description: Krishna temple within the City Palace complex.

pois.name: Johari Bazaar
pois.description: Old-city jewellery and textile market.

pois.name: Bapu Bazaar
pois.description: Market for mojaris, textiles and handicrafts.

pois.name: Tripolia Bazaar
pois.description: Lac bangles, brassware and ironware under the Tripolia Gate.

pois.name: Sisodia Rani Garden
pois.description: Terraced Mughal-style garden with murals of Krishna legends.

pois.name: Anokhi Museum of Hand Printing
pois.description: Block-printing museum in a restored haveli in Amer; closed Mondays.

pois.name: Panna Meena ka Kund
pois.description: Symmetrical 16th-century stepwell near Amber Fort.

pois.name: Chokhi Dhani
pois.description: Rajasthani village-themed resort with folk performances and dinner.

pois.name: Masala Chowk
pois.description: Open-air food court of Jaipur's famous street-food stalls in Ram Niwas Bagh.

pois.name: Laxmi Mishthan Bhandar (LMB)
pois.description: Landmark sweet shop and vegetarian restaurant in Johari Bazaar.

pois.name: Rawat Mishthan Bhandar
pois.description: Famous for pyaaz kachori.

pois.name: Jawahar Kala Kendra
pois.description: Arts centre designed by Charles Correa on the navagraha plan.

pois.name: Isarlat (Swargasuli)
pois.description: Victory tower with a panoramic view of the old city.

pois.name: Gaitore Ki Chhatriyan
pois.description: Royal cenotaphs of the Kachhwaha rulers.

pois.name: Amrapali Museum
pois.description: Museum of Indian jewellery and silver objects.

pois.name: Central Park
pois.description: Large city park with a jogging track and India's tallest flag.

pois.name: World Trade Park
pois.description: Large modern shopping mall on JLN Marg.

pois.name: Jaipur Wax Museum
pois.description: Wax figures and a Sheesh Mahal inside Nahargarh Fort.

pois.name: Moti Dungri Ganesh Temple
pois.description: Popular Ganesh temple at the foot of Moti Dungri hill.

pois.name: Kanak Vrindavan Garden
pois.description: Landscaped garden and temple complex in the Nahargarh foothills.
